name: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Ltd
about: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited is in the business of refining crude oil to produce & supply various petroleum products and manufacture and sale of lubricating oil additives.[1]
keyPoints: Product Offering [1] The company’s business primarily involves refining crude oil into a wide range of petroleum products for various end-use sectors like transportation, power generation, manufacturing, agriculture, and infrastructure. Its portfolio includes petrol and high-speed diesel for transportation, aviation turbine fuel (ATF), LPG for domestic and commercial use, lubricants and wax, naphtha and other petrochemical feedstocks, as well as speciality products like mineral turpentine oil, hexane, JP-5, JP-7 and ISROSENE.
